text: Welcome to Ryoko: the all-in-one travel app, tailored to you, for a smoother trip from the moment you land.
Ever felt overwhelmed finding your way around a foreign country? Say you're in Nara, Japan. Ryoko shows what's around you: temples, coffee shops and local favourites, picked for you.

Japan is famous for its great-value 7-Elevens. Tap one, and Ryoko writes the phrases you'll need right there: two onigiri, your usual iced coffee, and a check for peanuts, because it knows about your allergy.
Each phrase says why it's there, and opens full screen to show the staff. Flip it, and it faces them.
It all comes from your profile. In the Me tab, you set your allergies, diet and travel style, and Ryoko takes them into account everywhere.

Ryoko also helps you understand where you are. Tap Nara Park, famous for its friendly, bowing deer, and Ryoko shares the customs worth knowing: bow back, hold the cracker up, and show empty hands when you're done. And keep your paper map out of reach. The deer will try.
One of the hardest parts of travel is the language barrier. So Ryoko has live, split-screen translation built in. No waiting, and no passing the phone back and forth.
Say you're ordering coffee in Shanghai. You ask, "What do you recommend for coffee?" Ryoko translates as you speak, and the barista's answer comes back in English moments later.

Lay the phone flat and the screen splits. The top half turns to face the barista, in Chinese, while your half stays in English. Each translation expands to fill the screen, large and easy to read from across the counter.

And for everything else, there's Mimo, your travel companion. Ask it anything, like, "Help me plan a 3-hour tour nearby." Mimo checks the web, builds a walking plan around where you are and what you like, adds the phrase you'll need at the gate, and puts it all on the map.

Travelling abroad shouldn't mean juggling maps, translators and search engines. Ryoko brings personalized phrases, local customs, split-screen translation and a travel assistant into one app, so you can explore with confidence and focus on making memories.
